steps.what: Check the actual logs and storage access against production requirements
Compare recorded log lots with transportation schedules and required dimensions
Choose log selection and movement priorities for actual yard conditions
Write the actual log movement instructions for the yard crew

outputs: understood movement priorities and live coordination

tasks.design: Generate the fixed lot-to-requirement comparison from {OPS_SYSTEM} instead of assembling it in {SPREADSHEET}, and reuse lot and schedule fields in working instructions in {DOCS}. The supervisor checks real yard conditions, chooses the sequence and coordinates directly with the crew.
tasks.previous_blocker: Log references and transport constraints are manually compared and rewritten before yard coordination.
tasks.enabler_now: Native lot views and exact dimension and deadline comparisons remove fixed clerical work.
tasks.still_hard: Physical accessibility, log condition and safe movement depend on actual yard conditions.
tasks.human_edge: Choose workable priorities when book availability differs from the yard.

ambition.what: Log selection and yard coordination remain with the supervisor.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: log-lot dimensions and transport deadlines can be compared deterministically while yard condition and movement choices remain human.

assumptions: OTHER means the actual log yard and ordinary crew coordination. Boundary is supervisor coordination and its real working instructions, not vehicle operation, external dispatch or an invented post-movement report.

Stock staff maintain lot id, location, dimensions and quantity; planners maintain production requirements and transport times. s1 counts physical verification and s4 captures the actual chosen sequence. Missing lot or schedule fields require funded manual repair.

s2 replaces actual manual fixed comparison. s4 removes seven units of repeated lot and time fields, retaining13 for sequence, access details and checks. Native functions already used earn no new saving.

Working instructions are used in the actual crew briefing. Ordinary author saving is negligible, fully retained and ungated; the live coordination remains human and no automatic movement command is issued.
unknowns: Accuracy of lot location and dimension records
research_questions: Can inaccessible lots be excluded after the supervisor's physical check?

tasks.design: Use native resource conflict checks across {PROJECT} and {CALENDAR}, then reuse verified site and resource fields in the proposed schedule. The supervisor chooses assignments and checks actual readiness before releasing that exact operative allocation to internal crews.

tasks.human_edge: Choose a safe and workable allocation when conditions change.

ambition.what: Resource allocation decisions remain with the supervisor.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native resource calendars can identify fixed conflicts while site readiness and practical allocation remain supervisor decisions.

assumptions: Boundary includes the actual operative internal schedule, not external carrier orders or employment decisions. No model scores workers or infers competence.

Site planners maintain work locations and requirements; resource owners maintain calendars. s1 counts the supervisor's verification of dates, location, resource ids and access, and s4 captures actual assignments. Missing calendars require funded manual comparison.
s2 replaces manual conflict comparison. s4 removes ten units of repeated site and resource fields, retaining15 for chosen assignments and exceptions. Native functions already active earn no saving.

s5 is the existing operational readiness check after the complete allocation exists. It gates the actual crew allocation release, not an ordinary author save. tasks.short: Perform accounting, marketing and personnel supervision

Check the final personnel time batch against actual crew work before release
Release only the checked personnel hours to the actual payroll input process

tasks.design: Replace manual time-sheet totals and payroll re-entry with native time exports from {OTHER} into draft {PAYROLL} inputs, using transparent calculations currently done in {SPREADSHEET}. The supervisor verifies actual hours before release and retains customer marketing and personnel conversations.
tasks.previous_blocker: Crew time is totalled and re-entered while supervisory conversations still need direct attention.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing time-registration exports can remove the documented payroll bridge without a model or staff-performance scoring.
tasks.still_hard: The supervisor must know whether recorded time reflects actual work and address personnel concerns fairly.
tasks.human_edge: Resolve factual time discrepancies and have accountable conversations with workers and customers.

ambition.what: Management judgement and conversations remain with the supervisor.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: crew-time totals and payroll input transfer can be deterministic while actual-hours authorisation, personnel support and customer discussions remain human.

assumptions: OTHER means the existing agricultural time-registration tool and ordinary staff interaction. Boundary is the supervisor's accounting-hours, marketing and personnel activity mix; no wage calculation, payment or employment decision is automated.

Workers already submit person id, date, actual hours and activity; their unchanged capture is outside the supervisor-labour boundary. s1 counts the supervisor's checking, correction and cost-centre capture. Missing or incompatible codes require funded manual repair.

s2 replaces actual manual totals and s3 the separate re-entry described in the digest. The import creates a draft batch only. Native exports are tried first, and existing automatic transfer earns no new labour saving.

s4 is the existing supervisor check of crew-reported actual hours, not approval of the author's notes. The release is the operative payroll-input commitment; it binds person, date, activity, cost centre and hours in the checked batch and changes void it. The current tiny release and ordinary ungated draft saves remain fully retained.
All30 marketing and personnel conversation units remain. Staff-data access and actual national consultation arrangements must be established; no worker pace or performance ranking is introduced.
research_questions: Can the supervisor trace every released hour to the checked crew record and correction?

tasks.short: Read stock, orders and shipping schedules to set work

Compare inventory and customer order quantities against required shipping times
outputs: fixed quantity comparison and draft dock-time work list

steps.what: Read the combined inventory, order and shipping picture and investigate discrepancies
inputs: fixed quantity comparison and draft dock-time work list

steps.what: Determine required activities from actual inventory condition and shipping priorities
Write actual activity changes into the working inventory and shipping work list
inputs: fixed quantity comparison and draft dock-time work list

tasks.design: Use native stock and accepted-order feeds in {OPS_SYSTEM} to generate the fixed quantity and dock-time work list now assembled in {SPREADSHEET}. The supervisor reads the combined picture, resolves exceptions and determines actual activities before completing the working list.
tasks.previous_blocker: Stock, order and shipment records are manually assembled and compared before work can be chosen.
tasks.enabler_now: Native feeds and fixed item, unit and deadline comparisons can remove the clerical bridge.
tasks.still_hard: Book stock may not be harvestable, usable or available at the required time.
tasks.human_edge: Turn recorded demand into realistic activities under current operating conditions.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: existing stock, accepted orders and shipping times can feed fixed work-list comparisons while actual operating priorities remain supervisor judgement.

assumptions: Boundary is reading and determining work with the actual daily working list, not issuing external transport orders or formal crew allocations. The list is used in planning, not an invented after-action record.

Stock staff produce item, location, quantity, unit and usable-status records. Sales staff produce accepted item, quantity and due-time order lines; shipping planners maintain dock times. Their existing capture is unchanged, and missing fields are not inferred.

s1 replaces actual manual record assembly and s2 fixed comparisons. Free-text orders remain manual unless separately verified; failed mapping or stale stock requires funded manual repair. Native views and feeds are tested before custom code; current automatic runtime earns no saving.

All25 reading and exception units,15 priority-decision units and five actual list-edit units remain. Ordinary author saving within the working list is negligible and ungated. No machine decides crop condition or employee performance.
unknowns: Completeness of stock, order and dock-time fields
research_questions: Can stale stock and mismatched units be visible before the supervisor decides the activity list?

incremental.description: Maintain feed and unit mappings and manually repair missing or stale operating inputs
